from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

CONTROL = ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/worker_control_plane.py"
PLANNER = ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/worker_repair_planner.py"
AUTO = ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/worker_repair_auto_loop.py"


def test_control_plane_advances_repairs_outside_detector():
    text = CONTROL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "automatic_repair = automatic_repair_orchestration()" in text
    assert (
        "automatic_repair_execution = advance_repair_automation("
        in text
    )
    assert '"automatic_repair_execution": automatic_repair_execution' in text


def test_detector_boundary_remains_separate():
    text = CONTROL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    start = text.index("def automatic_repair_orchestration(")
    end = text.index("def maintenance_runtime_summary(", start)

    helper = text[start:end]

    assert "publish_planned_repair(" not in helper
    assert "reconcile_repair_result(" not in helper
    assert "CERTIFIED_WORKER_REPAIR" not in helper


def test_auto_loop_only_orchestrates_existing_components():
    text = AUTO.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "planner.publish_planned_repair(" in text
    assert "execution.reconcile_repair_result(" in text
    assert "execution.read_repair_terminal_result(" in text
    assert "maintenance.audit_runtime_incident(" in text
    assert "ensure_submit_convergence(" in text
    assert "resolve_learned_capability(" in text

    assert "subprocess" not in text
    assert "shell=True" not in text
    assert "universal_job_dispatcher" not in text
    assert "worker/requests" not in text


def test_auto_loop_requires_certified_result_before_audit():
    text = AUTO.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert 'certification != "CERTIFIED"' in text
    assert "WAIT_RESULT_CERTIFICATION" in text


def test_planner_uses_safe_convergence():
    text = PLANNER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "ensure_submit_convergence" in text
    assert 'owner="worker-repair-planner"' in text
    assert "DEV_MIRROR_NOT_CONVERGED:" in text


def test_planner_accepts_inherited_requester():
    text = PLANNER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "requester: dict[str, Any] | None = None" in text
    assert "_canonical_requester(requester)" in text


def test_production_remains_forbidden():
    control = CONTROL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    auto = AUTO.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert '"production_touched": False' in control
    assert '"production_touched": False' in auto
    assert "Edarsahub_Produccion" not in auto

from __future__ import annotations

from types import SimpleNamespace

import json
import pytest

from tools.mirror_sync import worker_repair_capability_registry as registry


def incident(paths=None):
    return SimpleNamespace(
        incident_id=(
            "EDARSAHUB-BOS-WORKER-MUTATION-LIFECYCLE-"
            "STALE-OWNERSHIP-R1"
        ),
        target_paths=tuple(
            paths
            or (
                "tools/mirror_sync/worker_control_plane.py",
                "backend/tests/test_worker_universal_queue_sla_contract.py",
                "backend/tests/test_worker_control_plane_contract.py",
            )
        ),
    )


def payload():
    return {
        "schema": registry.SCHEMA,
        "code": "MUTATION_LIFECYCLE_STALE_OWNERSHIP",
        "problem_signature": (
            "PROCESSING_STALE_WITH_LIVE_EXECUTION_OWNERSHIP"
        ),
        "incident_ids": [
            incident().incident_id,
        ],
        "incident_patterns": [
            "EDARSAHUB-BOS-WORKER-MUTATION-LIFECYCLE-*",
        ],
        "required_paths": list(incident().target_paths),
        "objective": (
            "Prevent stale requeue or terminalization while the same "
            "job still has live canonical execution ownership."
        ),
        "actions": [
            {
                "type": "replace_text",
                "path": "tools/mirror_sync/worker_control_plane.py",
                "old": "old-anchor",
                "new": "new-anchor",
                "expected_count": 1,
            },
        ],
        "checks": [
            {
                "type": "py_compile",
                "paths": [
                    "tools/mirror_sync/worker_control_plane.py",
                ],
            },
            {
                "type": "pytest",
                "paths": [
                    "backend/tests/test_worker_universal_queue_sla_contract.py",
                    "backend/tests/test_worker_control_plane_contract.py",
                ],
            },
            {"type": "git_diff_check"},
        ],
        "evidence": {
            "source_job_id": (
                "EDARSAHUB-BOS-CONEXIONES-COMUNICACIONES-"
                "SERVIDORES-CANONICAL-INVENTORY-UI-FIX-R1-20261022"
            ),
            "blocker_signature": (
                "processing_stale_after_single_requeue"
            ),
        },
        "learned_from_incident": incident().incident_id,
        "reusable": True,
        "production_allowed": False,
    }


def test_register_and_reuse_by_signature(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    registry_dir = tmp_path / "registry"
    seed_dir = tmp_path / "seed"

    monkeypatch.setattr(registry, "REGISTRY_DIR", registry_dir)
    monkeypatch.setattr(registry, "SEED_DIR", seed_dir)

    result = registry.register_learned_capability(
        payload(),
        incident=incident(),
    )

    assert result["status"] == "REGISTERED"
    assert result["production_touched"] is False

    learned = registry.resolve_learned_capability(
        incident_id="FUTURE-UNSEEN-INCIDENT",
        problem_signature=(
            "PROCESSING_STALE_WITH_LIVE_EXECUTION_OWNERSHIP"
        ),
    )

    assert learned is not None
    assert learned.code == "MUTATION_LIFECYCLE_STALE_OWNERSHIP"


def test_seed_registry_payload_conflict_fails_closed(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    registry_dir = tmp_path / "registry"
    seed_dir = tmp_path / "seed"

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        registry,
        "REGISTRY_DIR",
        registry_dir,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        registry,
        "SEED_DIR",
        seed_dir,
    )

    result = registry.register_learned_capability(
        payload(),
        incident=incident(),
    )

    assert result["status"] == "REGISTERED"

    seed_dir.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    conflicting = payload()
    conflicting["objective"] = (
        "Conflicting seed payload must fail closed."
    )

    (
        seed_dir
        / "MUTATION_LIFECYCLE_STALE_OWNERSHIP.json"
    ).write_text(
        json.dumps(
            conflicting,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="LEARNED_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_CONFLICT",
    ):
        registry.iter_learned_capabilities()


def test_scope_escape_fails_closed(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(registry, "REGISTRY_DIR", tmp_path)
    value = payload()
    value["required_paths"].append("frontend/src/App.jsx")
    value["actions"][0]["path"] = "frontend/src/App.jsx"

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="LEARNED_CAPABILITY_SCOPE_NOT_AUTHORIZED",
    ):
        registry.register_learned_capability(
            value,
            incident=incident(),
        )


def test_shell_sql_and_production_are_forbidden():
    value = payload()
    value["actions"][0]["shell"] = "rm -rf /"

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="LEARNED_CAPABILITY_FORBIDDEN_RECIPE_KEY:shell",
    ):
        registry.normalize_learned_capability(value)

    value = payload()
    value["production_allowed"] = True

    with pytest.raises(
        ValueError,
        match="LEARNED_CAPABILITY_PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN",
    ):
        registry.normalize_learned_capability(value)


def test_unknown_without_registry_remains_unknown(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(registry, "REGISTRY_DIR", tmp_path)

    assert registry.resolve_learned_capability(
        incident_id="UNKNOWN",
        problem_signature="UNKNOWN_SIGNATURE",
    ) is None


def test_registration_is_idempotent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(registry, "REGISTRY_DIR", tmp_path)

    first = registry.register_learned_capability(
        payload(),
        incident=incident(),
    )
    second = registry.register_learned_capability(
        payload(),
        incident=incident(),
    )

    assert first["status"] == "REGISTERED"
    assert second["status"] == "ALREADY_REGISTERED"
